name: Briefer
title: briefer.cloud
shortDescription: Briefer is a versatile data platform designed for engineers and data scientists. It integrates SQL and Python capabilities, allowing users to create visualizations, run analyses, and share insights. Teams can collaborate in real-time, turning notebooks into interactive dashboards or full-fledged data apps. An example use case is a team using Briefer to streamline their data analysis process, enhancing productivity and insight generation.
pros: Built-in AI analyst for automated tasks
cons: Potentially steep learning curve for non-technical users

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: Looker
